cache_hit_rate_definition: features_valid in excess of fresh backend_valid, as a fraction of total valid features; an estimate derived from already-published counters, not a dedicated cache-hit counter.
latency_unavailable_reason: tools/experiments/run_deterministic_tim_replay.py hardcodes lat_ms=0.0 and appearance_backend_wall_ms=0.0 (verified in source): deterministic replay never measures wall time. Reporting these as zero would silently fabricate an implausible zero-latency claim. Genuine TIM core / MARS extraction latency percentiles come only from measurement_mode=live_sustained.
